'''Ekim Ryelli''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He [[Death/Legends|died]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] on [[Nicht Ka]], killed by [[Malleus]], a failed Jedi who had been corrupted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

==Biography==
===Geonosis Arena===
[[File:KeLoDerphiReal.jpg|thumb|left|The Jedi kicking a Battle Droid.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he and his apprentice [[Lumas Etima]] were present in the [[Petranaki arena]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. While Ryelli lost three fingers during the combat, Etima was overpowered by the sheer number of enemy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Death/Legends|died]] in the arena. Maimed physically and mentally, Ryelli lost the will to fight. He retired from combat and requested to be reassigned as a [[Jedi archaeologist]] instead.<ref name="SWI" />

===Death on Nicht Ka===
[[File:Muder_of_Ryelli.jpg|thumb|Malleus preparing to kill Ryelli]]
Four years later, in the final days of the Clone Wars, the Jedi Master was sent to [[Nicht Ka]], a forgotten planet located on the border of the late [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], where a mysterious structure had been discovered. When he arrived there with two members of the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]], a Givin astrogator [[Staguu Itincoovar]] and the Human [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Malleus|Telloti Cillmam'n]], the archaeologist started examining a few carving on the walls. He allowed Cillmam'n to look around the place while Itincoovar was searching their [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] database. A bit later, Ryelli found the pilot in another room, wearing an ancient suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] which he felt was infested with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Cillmam'n then confronted Ryelli, blaming him for giving up the fight after what happened on Geonosis. The two men [[Duel on Nicht Ka|engaged]] in a fierce lightsaber duel, and although Ryelli seemed to get the upper hand, the other took the high ground by using a secondary blade from his lightsaber's butt. Ekim Ryelli was then [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] at the very moment Itincoovar tried to contact him via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to announce that the Clone Wars had been won by the Republic.<ref name="SWI" />
